xStretch.name: Horizontal fabric stretch (%)
xStretch.help: Adjust this for more or less stretchy fabric in the horizontal direction

yStretch.name: Vertical fabric stretch (%)
yStretch.help: Adjust this for more or less stretchy fabric in the vertical direction

elasticStretch.name: Elastic stretch (%)
elasticStretch.help: Adjust how much the elastics are stretched relative to the fabric

gussetPosition.name: Gusset position (%)
gussetPosition.help: Shift the gusset (crotch position with the smallest width) forwards or backwards. The default position equals the cross seam front measurement.

gussetWidth.name: Gusset width (%)
gussetWidth.help: Controls the minimum width in the crotch area

splitPosition.name: Crotch seam (%)
splitPosition.help: Determines the position of the crotch seam

bulge.name: Bulge (°)
bulge.help: Increase the bugle angle to create more room in the front pouch. Doesn't kick in below 2 degrees.

minFabricWidth.name: Minimum fabric width (%)
minFabricWidth.help: Controls the minimum width of the thong strip and side band. Does not have an effect if the back exposure and the leg rise is low.

frontReduction.name: Front narrowing (%)
frontReduction.help: Controls by how much the front part is slimmer than the back part

rise.name: Rise (%)
rise.help: Controls the height of the waist. A value of 100% puts the waistband onto the measured hip line.

legRise.name: Leg rise (%)
legRise.help: Controls how high the leg is cut out

frontDip.name: Front waist dip (%)
frontDip.help: Controls how much the front waist curves (revealing more or less skin)

frontDipShape.name: Front waist dip shape (%)
frontDipShape.help: Controls the shape of the front waist dip. Doesn't have much effect if the front waist dip is zero.

frontExposure.name: Front exposure (%)
frontExposure.help: Controls the amount of exposed skin on the front

backDip.name: Back waist dip (%)
backDip.help: Controls how much the back waist curves (revealing more or less skin)

backDipShape.name: Back waist dip shape (%)
backDipShape.help: Controls the shape of the back waist dip. Doesn't have much effect if the back waist dip is zero.

backExposure.name: Back exposure (%)
backExposure.help: Controls the amount of exposed skin on the back

bulgeFullness.name: Bulge fullness (%)
bulgeFullness.help: Determines the roundness of the bulge. Doesn't have an effect if the bulge is disabled.

pocketGap.name: Pocket gap (%)
pocketGap.help: Controls how much space is left in the front between both pockets. Only has an effect with pockets enabled.

pocketHeight.name: Pocket height (%)
pocketHeight.help: Controls the position of the pocket hem or the zippers. Increasing this option results in shorter pockets. Only has an effect with pockets enabled.

flipBack.name: Flip back
flipBack.help: Determines if the back part should be rendered upside down
